Figure 2d Source Data
=====================

DATA FILE
---------
File: Figure2d_Data.csv

COLUMN DESCRIPTIONS
-------------------
Item1             : First item of the pair (1-8)
Item2             : Second item of the pair (1-8)
alpha             : Fitted alpha parameter (0-1)
beta              : Fitted beta parameter (0-1)
distribution_type : Model classification (bimodal/unimodal/high-accuracy/low-accuracy)

DATA SUMMARY
------------
Total pairs : 28 (8×8 matrix lower triangle)

PLOTTING
--------
Plot type    : Lower triangle heatmap
